## Example 7.3(c) {#ss7-example-7-3-c .lim-lesson }

For each of the following series, evaluate the limiting sums provided they exist.

<div class="lim-example-parts">

**(c)** $2+\sqrt2+1+\cdots$

</div>

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 45 · Example 7.3(c)</p>

::: notes

Complete in OneNote. a=2, r=√2/2=1/√2, so |r|<1. S_infinity=2/(1−1/√2)=2√2/(√2−1)=4+2√2. Keep exact arithmetic and rationalise the denominator. Students may incorrectly use √2 as the ratio. Ask which number multiplies 2 to give √2.

:::
